justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/CopyUtils.java`, `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/CopyUtilsTest.java`, and `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/IOUtilsTest.java`. `CopyUtils` is a deprecated static utility with a small, direct dependency set (`IOUtils.byteArray()`, `IOUtils.ScratchChars`, and standard JDK stream/charset classes) and no production-code callers outside itself; the only observed incoming references are from `CopyUtilsTest` and a few `IOUtilsTest` cases. That fan-in/fan-out pattern is not strong enough to qualify as a dependency hub.
